entity.name: Domnic Amalan S
entity.description: Creator and maintainer of MedBrains, a free, open-source hospital operating system: cheap by design, top quality, simple out of the box, so that every hospital, big or small, can give safe care and create local jobs supporting it.

projects.name: MedBrains
projects.description: Free, open-source hospital operating system: registration, OPD, wards, nursing, pharmacy, lab, radiology and billing on one patient record, with patient-safety checks built in (drug interactions, narcotics rules, barcode-verified medicine administration, critical lab alerts) and regulatory compliance built into the core. Rust and PostgreSQL, with web, desktop and native iOS/Android apps, and an installable OS image that runs on modest hardware. ABDM M1-M4 supported, interoperable through HL7 FHIR R4, HL7 v2 and DICOM, and self-hostable so small, rural and charitable hospitals can run it at no licence cost.

channels.description: Bank transfer to the maintainer. Write to ceo@medbrains.in for account details and an invoice.

plans.name: Core development and maintenance
plans.description: One year of full-time maintenance and development: security fixes and CVE tracking for every release, dependency updates, regulatory packs (India first: NDPS, Schedule H, DPDP, CERT-In), on-box AI that works under the same access rules as staff, ABDM certification, the hospital OS installer and fleet updates, documentation, and reviewing community contributions.

plans.name: Go-live for a charitable hospital
plans.description: Setting up, migrating data and training staff so a charitable, trust or government hospital can go live on MedBrains at no cost to it.
